visual.name: zentrixFinancialChart
visual.description: An advanced financial time-series visual: candlestick, OHLC, line and area charts with a professional time axis, display-only zoom and pan, an OHLC crosshair, volume and technical indicators.

dataRoles.description: Required. The time axis — one row per period. A date, a date/time, or an auto date hierarchy all work; the chart flattens a hierarchy back into a timestamp. If several rows share a period, set the aggregations below or the bars will be wrong.
dataRoles.name: date

dataRoles.description: Optional. The FIRST value in each period — an opening price, the first sale of the day, the reading at the start of a shift. Aggregate as First. Bind Open, High and Low alongside Close to draw candles.
dataRoles.name: open

dataRoles.description: Optional. The MAXIMUM value in each period — a session high, a peak temperature, the busiest minute. Aggregate as Maximum.
dataRoles.name: high

dataRoles.description: Optional. The MINIMUM value in each period — a session low, a trough, the quietest minute. Aggregate as Minimum.
dataRoles.name: low

dataRoles.description: Required. The LAST value in each period — a closing price, the final sale, the reading at the end of a shift. Bound on its own it draws a line or area; add Open, High and Low for candles. Aggregate as Last.
dataRoles.name: close

dataRoles.description: Optional. How much happened in each period — units traded, items sold, requests served. Drawn as its own pane below the chart, and used by VWAP.
dataRoles.name: volume

dataRoles.description: Optional. Extra fields to show in the tooltip.
dataRoles.name: tooltips

dataRoles.description: Optional. Splits the data into several series — one per security, site, sensor or product. With more than one series the chart draws lines rather than candles, because overlaid candles cannot be read; use % change or Indexed under Layout to compare them fairly.
dataRoles.name: series

dataRoles.description: Optional. A field or measure that decides each bar's colour, instead of the up/down rule. Use it to colour by signal, status, session or any category.
dataRoles.name: colorBy

dataRoles.description: Optional. One or more measures drawn as horizontal reference lines — a target, an entry, a stop, a control limit. Bind Reference label alongside to name them.
dataRoles.name: refValue

dataRoles.description: Optional. Names for the reference lines, in the same order as the Reference value fields.
dataRoles.name: refLabel
